segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thanks for calling support, this is Maya. Can I get your company name and the email on your admin account?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, so this is Daniel at Northstar Commercial Interiors. Admin email is daniel.cho@northstarci.com.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thanks, Daniel. I have your account pulled up. What can I help with today?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: We need to add three users for the operations team before Monday. I wasn't sure if we had seats available or if we need to add them to the plan.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Sure, I can check that in the admin console. Looks like you're on the Business plan with 48 seats purchased and 45 assigned, so you have exactly three open seats.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. The emails are marisa.patel@northstarci.com, kevin.ross@northstarci.com, and tina.owens@northstarci.com.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Got it. I'm adding them now with standard user access. Do they need to be in the Chicago project workspace, or just the main company workspace?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Just main company for now. We'll move them into projects after training.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Okay, all three users are created and invitation emails have been sent. They should see those within a minute or two. No billing change since you already had the open seats.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great, that's all I needed. Can you send me the ticket number for our records?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Absolutely. Ticket number is 184726. You'll also get a confirmation email with the three user emails listed.
